```{r}
# set package parameters
theme_set(theme_bw())

n_cores <- max(1, parallelly::availableCores() - 4)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 3000 * 1024^2)
future::plan(future::multisession, workers = n_cores, maxSizeOfObjects = 10e9)
doFuture::registerDoFuture()
doRNG::registerDoRNG()

options(marginaleffects_parallel_inferences = TRUE)
options(marginaleffects_parallel_packages = c("marginaleffects", "glmtoolbox", "glmmTMB"))
options(marginaleffects_parallel = TRUE)

options(glmmTMB.cores=n_cores)

lmerctrl <- lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                               optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6))
glmerctrl <- lme4::glmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                 optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6))

glmmTMBctrl <- glmmTMB::glmmTMBControl(profile=TRUE, collect=TRUE,
                                       optimizer = optim,
                                       optArgs = list(method='BFGS'))

buildMerctrl <- buildmer::buildmerControl(crit = 'AIC',
                                             direction = c("order", "backward"))

```

```{r}

subjDataPath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest2_testdata_BySubj.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 2\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest2_testdata_BySubj.csv", "refmap_listest2_testdata_BySubj.csv"), ncol=2))

subjData <- read.csv(subjDataPath, header=TRUE)

stimDataPath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest2_testdata_ByStim.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 2\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest2_testdata_ByStim.csv", "refmap_listest2_testdata_ByStim.csv"), ncol=2))
```

```{r}

# rename variables for ease
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::rename(TrialNumber = Trial) |>
  arrange(ID, TrialNumber)

subjData$AmbientEnvCore <- subjData$AmbientEnv |>
  dplyr::recode("Park (high)" = "Park",
                "Highway (low)" = "Highway") |>
  factor(levels=c("Park", "Residential", "Streetside square", "Highway"))

subjData$AmbientVariant <- factor(dplyr::case_when(
  subjData$AmbientEnv == "Park (high)" ~ "ParkHigh",
  subjData$AmbientEnv == "Highway (low)" ~ "HighwayLow",
  TRUE ~ "Standard"
  ), levels = c("Standard", "ParkHigh", "HighwayLow"))

stimData$AmbientEnvCore <- stimData$AmbientEnv |>
  dplyr::recode("Park (high)" = "Park",
                "Highway (low)" = "Highway") |>
  factor(levels=c("Park", "Residential", "Streetside square", "Highway"))

stimData$AmbientVariant <- factor(dplyr::case_when(
  stimData$AmbientEnv == "Park (high)" ~ "ParkHigh",
  stimData$AmbientEnv == "Highway (low)" ~ "HighwayLow",
  TRUE ~ "Standard"
  ), levels = c("Standard", "ParkHigh", "HighwayLow"))

stimData$UASOperation <- factor(stimData$UASOperation, levels=UASOpCats)
stimData$UASType <- factor(stimData$UASType, levels=UASTypeCats)
stimData$UASStart <- factor(stimData$UASStart, levels=UASStartCats)
stimData$UASProximity <- factor(stimData$UASProximity, levels=UASProximityCats)

                                                                   "SouthAsia",
                                                                   "Australasia",

                                                                   "SouthAmerica",

# recode Area of residence to 2 groups
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(Home_Area2 = dplyr::recode_values(HomeArea,

# recode Area soundscape to 2 groups

# add a rescaled dAnnoyance variable
```

## rescaling variables

```{r}

# rescale variables

centre_vars = c("UASLAF50ExMaxLR", "UASLAEMaxLR", "UASImpulsLoudWZAvg",
                "UASRoughECMA10Ex", "UASSharpvBISO105Ex",
                "UASRoughDW10Ex", "UASFluctOV10Ex",
                "UASFluctECMA10Ex", "UASTonLdECMAPowAvg", "UASPsychAnnoyWidmann",
                "UASPsychAnnoyWillemsen",
                "UASLoudISO1PowAvg", "Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLR",
                "UASImpulsSHMAvg", "dImpulsSHM05Ex",
                "UASImpulsLoudWZPowAvg", "PartSharpvBSHMPowAvg",
                "UASSharpAurISO1Med", "dRoughECMA05Ex",
                "dImpulsLoudWZAvg", "PartTonLdSHMPowAvg",
                "UASFluctFZ05Ex", "dFluctOV10Ex", "UASTonShpAurSHM05Ex",
                "dTonalECMAAvg", "dTonalAwSHM05Ex", "UASTonalECMA05Ex",
                "EPNLLAF50diff", "LAELAF50diff", "LAeqLAF10diff",
                "LAeqdiff", "dPsychAnnoyDi", "dPsychAnnoyWidmann", 
                 "Age", "NoiseSensitivity")

standardise_vars = c("TrialNumber", setdiff(centre_vars, c("Age", "NoiseSensitivity")))

out <- standardise_list(list(subjData, subjDataNoAmb),
                        vars = list(standardise=standardise_vars,
                                    centre=centre_vars),
                        append=c(standardise="Std", centre="Scl"))

subjData <- out$data$subjData
subjDataNoAmb <- out$data$subjDataNoAmb

subjDataScaling <- subset(out$params, df_name=='subjData')
subjDataNoAmbScaling <- subset(out$params, df_name=='subjDataNoAmb')

centre_stim_vars = setdiff(centre_vars, c("Age", "NoiseSensitivity"))

standardise_stim_vars = setdiff(standardise_vars, c("TrialNumber"))

out <- standardise_list(list(stimData, stimDataNoAmb),
                        vars = list(standardise=standardise_stim_vars,
                                    centre=centre_stim_vars),
                        append=c(standardise="Std", centre="Scl"))

stimData <- out$data$stimData
stimDataNoAmb <- out$data$stimDataNoAmb

stimDataScaling <- subset(out$params, df_name=='stimData')
stimDataNoAmbScaling <- subset(out$params, df_name=='stimDataNoAmb')

stimDataNoAmbPlot <- to_model_cols(stimDataNoAmb, subjDataNoAmbScaling)

log10evts_centre <- mean(log10(subjDataNoAmb$UASEvents))
print(log10evts_centre, digits=20)
# [1] 0.16481024864599216895
# we use 0.16481 to centre

expDetect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl <- mean(exp(0.02*subjDataNoAmb$Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl))
print(expDetect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl, digits=20)
# [1] 1.0304874359775315629
# we use 1.030487436 to centre

expLAELAF50diffScl <- mean(exp(0.0225*subjDataNoAmb$LAELAF50diffScl))
print(expLAELAF50diffScl, digits=20)

# [1] 1.0389561193949696793
# we use 1.03895612 to centre

expEPNLLAF50diffScl <- mean(exp(0.03*subjDataNoAmb$EPNLLAF50diffScl))
print(expEPNLLAF50diffScl, digits=20)

# [1] 1.072727814277170566
```

## Aalmoes (NLR) HA curves

```{r}

paramKNLR <- c(0.168, 0.152, 0.138, 0.158, 0.189, 0.148, 0.116, 0.085)
paramX0LAENLR <- c(82.2, 78.9, 77.4, 81.8, 81.0, 83.8, 92.2, 93.4)

rangeLAENLR <- seq(50, 90, by=0.1)

pHALAENLRFunc <- function(paramK, paramX0, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-paramK*(abscissa - paramX0)))
  return(pHA)
} 

pHALAENLR <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAENLR,
                        LAEScl = rangeLAENLR - lae_centre,
                        Quad1=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[1], paramX0LAENLR[1], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad2=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[2], paramX0LAENLR[2], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad3=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[3], paramX0LAENLR[3], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad4=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[4], paramX0LAENLR[4], rangeLAENLR))

pHALAENLR <- pHALAENLR |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Quad1, Quad2, Quad3, Quad4), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAENLR LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRAdj <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                           LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAENLR
pHALAENLRUASRange <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

# adjust pHALAENLRUASRange LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRUASRangeAdj <- pHALAENLRUASRange |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                           LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

pHALAENLRAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAENLR,
                           LAEScl = rangeLAENLR - lae_centre,
                           Air_taxi=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[6], paramX0LAENLR[6], rangeLAENLR),
                           Helicopter_1=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[7], paramX0LAENLR[7], rangeLAENLR),
                           Helicopter_2=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[8], paramX0LAENLR[8], rangeLAENLR))

pHALAENLRAir <- pHALAENLRAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Air_taxi, Helicopter_1, Helicopter_2), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAENLRAir LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRAirAdj <- pHALAENLRAir |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                 LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAENLRSel <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAENLRSelAir <- pHALAENLRAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)


```

## Kawai (EMPA) HA curves

```{r}

paramb0EMPA <- c(-11.06)
paramb1LAEEMPA<- c(0.17)
paramtauSrcEMPA <- c(-0.91)

rangeLAEEMPA <- seq(53, 80, by=0.1)

pHALAEEMPAFunc <- function(paramb0, paramb1, paramtau, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-(paramb0 + paramb1*abscissa + paramtau)))
  return(pHA)
} 

pHALAEEMPA <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEEMPA,
                         LAEScl = rangeLAEEMPA - lae_centre,
                        Mav2=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            0, rangeLAEEMPA),
                        M300=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauSrcEMPA[1], rangeLAEEMPA))

pHALAEEMPA <- pHALAEEMPA |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Mav2, M300), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAEEMPA
pHALAEEMPAUASRange <- pHALAEEMPA |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

paramtauAirEMPA <- c(-1.66, -1.68, -1.76)

pHALAEEMPAAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEEMPA,
                            LAEScl = rangeLAEEMPA - lae_centre,
                        Helicopter=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauAirEMPA[1], rangeLAEEMPA),
                        Propeller=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauAirEMPA[2], rangeLAEEMPA),
                        Jet=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                           paramtauAirEMPA[3], rangeLAEEMPA))

pHALAEEMPAAir <- pHALAEEMPAAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Helicopter, Propeller, Jet), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAEEMPASel <- pHALAEEMPA |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAEEMPASelAir <- pHALAEEMPAAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)

```

## Gwak HA curves

```{r}

paramkGwak <- c(0.17, 0.178, 0.165)
param0LAeqGwak <- c(13.512, 13.47, 12.184)/paramkGwak

param0LAEGwak <- param0LAeqGwak + 10*log10(7)

rangeLAeqGwak <- seq(40, 85, by=0.1)
rangeLAEGwak <- rangeLAeqGwak + 10*log10(7)

pHALAEGwakFunc <- function(paramb0, paramk, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-paramk*(abscissa - paramb0)))
  return(pHA)
}

pHALAEGwak <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEGwak,
                         LAEScl = rangeLAEGwak - lae_centre,
                        H12W=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwak[1], paramkGwak[1],
                                             rangeLAEGwak),
                        F450=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwak[2], paramkGwak[2],
                                            rangeLAEGwak),
                        S1000=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwak[3], paramkGwak[3],
                                            rangeLAEGwak))

pHALAEGwak <- pHALAEGwak |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(H12W, F450, S1000), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAEGwak LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAEGwakAdj <- pHALAEGwak |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                             LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAEGwak
pHALAEGwakUASRange <- pHALAEGwak |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

# adjust pHALAEGwakUASRange LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAEGwakUASRangeAdj <- pHALAEGwakUASRange |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                             LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)


paramkGwakAir <- 0.229
param0LAEGwakAir <- 18.94/paramkGwakAir + 10*log10(7)

pHALAEGwakAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEGwak,
                             LAEScl = rangeLAEGwak - lae_centre,
                             Jet=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwakAir, paramkGwakAir,
                                                     rangeLAEGwak))

pHALAEGwakAir <- pHALAEGwakAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Jet), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAEGwakAir LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAEGwakAirAdj <- pHALAEGwakAir |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                   LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)


# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAEGwakSel <- pHALAEGwak |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAEGwakSelAir <- pHALAEGwakAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)



```

## Jeong HA curves

```{r}

paramkJeong <- 0.2753
param0LAeqJeong <- 19.817/paramkJeong

param0LAEJeong <- param0LAeqJeong + 10*log10(5)

rangeLAeqJeong <- seq(40, 80, by=1)
rangeLAEJeong <- rangeLAeqJeong + 10*log10(5)

pHALAEJeongFunc <- function(paramb0, paramk, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-paramk*(abscissa - paramb0)))
  return(pHA)
}

pHALAEJeong <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEJeong,
                         LAEScl = rangeLAEJeong - lae_centre,
                         Motor_prop=pHALAEJeongFunc(param0LAEJeong, paramkJeong,
                                                    rangeLAEJeong))

pHALAEJeong <- pHALAEJeong |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Motor_prop), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

```

# Change in mean annoyance rating

## Categorical variables

### fit logistic models: GEE fractional logit

```{r}

transform_dAnnoy <- \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')

```

#### model 1 formula

```{r}

# LAE-based model
m1formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ 1 + TrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)

# Factor-based model
m1bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ 1 + TrialNumberStd + AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientEnvCore*UASType + UASType*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  AmbientVariant + UASProximity + UASStart

# include personal factors
m1cformula <- update(m1formula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl +
                       Area_soundscape2)

m1dformula <- update(m1bformula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl +
                       Area_soundscape2)

m1Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(TrialNumber='TrialNumber', StimID='StimID', ID='ID',
                            all.vars(m1formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m1bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(TrialNumber='TrialNumber', StimID='StimID', ID='ID',
                             all.vars(m1bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m1cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(TrialNumber='TrialNumber', StimID='StimID', ID='ID',
                             all.vars(m1cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m1dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(TrialNumber='TrialNumber', StimID='StimID', ID='ID',
                             all.vars(m1dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m1formula, data=m1Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m1bformula, data=m1bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m1cformula, data=m1cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m1dformula, data=m1dData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m1 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1formula, data=m1Data,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m1b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1bformula, data=m1bData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m1c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1cformula, data=m1cData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m1d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1dformula, data=m1dData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m1, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m1b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m1c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m1d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1, m1b, m1c, m1d)

m1_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                data=na.omit(m1Data), agg_cols="StimID", return_predictions=TRUE,
                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                workers=n_cores) |>
  cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m1b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                data=na.omit(m1bData), agg_cols="StimID", return_predictions=TRUE,
                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                workers=n_cores) |>
  cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)


m1c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                data=na.omit(m1cData), agg_cols="StimID",
                return_predictions=TRUE,
                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                workers=n_cores) |>
  cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m1d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1d, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m1dData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
  cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

compare_cv_results(list(m1=m1_cv, m1b=m1b_cv, m1c=m1c_cv, m1d=m1d_cv))

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m1b.resP <- residuals(m1b, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE,

gee_residplot(m1b, residual_vals=m1b.resP,

glmgee_vif(m1b)
```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m1bpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m1b, newdata=na.omit(m1bData),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "UASProximity",
                                                       "UASEvents", "UASType",
                                                       "UASOperation", "AmbientEnvCore",
                                                       "AmbientVariant", "UASStart"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m1b, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean -
                      m1bpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean -
                                                       mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m1bpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m1bpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_Bmark_Cal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

```{r}
modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m1b,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m1bformula
modelStep$final
```

##### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m1bformula, data = m1bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m1bformula, data=m1bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m1bData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m1e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 500)

coef(m1e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m1e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m1e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m1e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m1e$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m1e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m1e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

```{r}
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
geeCluster_stemplot(m2, clusterVar=m2.Cook,
```

```{r}

                               scaling_data = subjDataNoAmb,
                               TrialNumberStd=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### full SQ model

#### model 3 formula

```{r}

m3formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd
# no interaction of T*S because it doesn't improve the model in CV


m3Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m3formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m3bformula <- update(m3formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)

m3bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m3bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m3aformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd
# no interaction of T*S because it doesn't improve the model in CV

m3aData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m3aformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m3cformula <- update(m3aformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)

m3cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m3cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m3formula, data=m3Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m3aformula, data=m3aData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m3bformula, data=m3bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m3cformula, data=m3cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m3 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3formula, data=m3Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m3a <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3aformula, data=m3aData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m3b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3bformula, data=m3bData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m3c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3cformula, data=m3cData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,

geeParams(m3, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m3a, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m3b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m3cpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m3c, newdata=na.omit(m3cData),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m3c, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m3cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m3cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m3cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=7.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=7, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 6.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)


```

```{r}
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',

m3cformula

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m3cformula, data = m3cData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m3cformula, data=m3cData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m3cData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m3d <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-8, nlambda = 200)

coef(m3d, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m3d, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m3d$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m3d$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m3d$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.55, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m3d$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m3d$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.55, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_LAESQ_glmnetQb"
 
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

```{r}
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=7.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=7, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 6.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_LAF50SQnetCal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 5 formula

```{r}

m5formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore + UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd

m5Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m5formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m5bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore + UASTonalECMA05ExStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd

m5bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m5bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m5cformula <- update(m5formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
                       UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)

m5cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m5cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m5dformula <- update(m5bformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
                       UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)

m5dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m5dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m5,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m5formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m5formula, data = m5Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m5formula, data=m5Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m5Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(99999)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(99999)
m5e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-300, nlambda = 2000)

coef(m5e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m5e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m5e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

col_pal <- randomcoloR::distinctColorPalette(k = length(unique(coefficient_paths$term)), altCol = FALSE, runTsne = FALSE)

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = col_pal) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m5e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m5e$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m5e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m5e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right') +

  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.15, 0.25))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m5gpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m5g, newdata=na.omit(m5Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m5g, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m5gpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m5gpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m5gpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_LAF50SQEnvnetCal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

### full SQ model

#### model 7 formula

```{r}

m7formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
              I(exp(0.03*EPNLLAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
              UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd
m7formula


m7Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m7formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m7bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
              I(exp(0.03*EPNLLAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
              UASTonalECMA05ExStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd
m7bformula

m7bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m7bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m7cformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
              I(exp(0.03*EPNLLAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
              UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd
m7cformula

m7cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m7cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))


m7dformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
              I(exp(0.03*EPNLLAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
              UASTonalECMA05ExStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd
m7dformula

m7dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m7dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m7eformula <- update(m7cformula, . ~ . - I(exp(0.03*EPNLLAF50diffScl)) +
                       I(exp(0.03*EPNLLAF50diffScl) - 1.0727278)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481))
m7eformula
```

```{r}
                  return_predictions=TRUE,

                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m7b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m7b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m7bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m7c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m7c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m7cData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m7d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m7d, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m7dData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m7e_cv <- cv_glmgee(m7e, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m7cData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3i, m4, m5g, m6, m7, m7b, m7c, m7d, m7e)
```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m7epredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m7e, newdata=na.omit(m7cData),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m7e, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m7epredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m7epredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m7epredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m7e,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m7eformula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m7eformula, data = m7cData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m7eformula, data=m7cData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m7cData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(9999)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(9999)
m7f <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-100, nlambda = 1000)

coef(m7f, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m7f, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m7f$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m7f$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m7f$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m7f$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m7f$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_dEPNLSQ_glmnetQb"
 
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

##### fit elastic net informed formula

```{r}

m7gformula <- update(m7eformula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExStd -
                       UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd - UASSharpvBISO105ExStd -
                       UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)
m7gformula

m7hformula <- update(m7eformula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExStd -
                       UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd - UASSharpvBISO105ExStd -
                       UASImpulsSHMAvgStd -
                       I(exp(0.03*EPNLLAF50diffScl) - 1.0727278):I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481))
m7hformula

m7iformula <- update(m7eformula, . ~ . - UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd - 
                       UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)
m7iformula

m7jformula <- update(m7eformula, . ~ . - UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd)
m7jformula


```


#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m7gpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m7g, newdata=na.omit(m7cData),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m7g, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m7gpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m7gpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m7gpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_dEPNLSQnetCal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

#### analyse population-average predictions

```{r}

pred_mod <- m7g
fitDat <- insight::get_data(pred_mod)
vc <- vcov(pred_mod, type="bias-corrected")

n_sweep  <- 25

x_main    <- "EPNLLAF50diffScl"

x_sweep <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmbPlot[[x_main]]),
               max(stimDataNoAmbPlot[[x_main]]),
               length.out=25)

transform_dAnnoy <- \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')

q_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)            # quantiles used for "low / mid / high" slices


m7gpredEnv <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmbScaling)


m7gpredEvt <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main, "UASEvents"),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmbScaling)

# sqm 3
sqm3 <- "UASRoughECMA10ExStd"
sqm3_orig <- subjDataNoAmbScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmbScaling$new_variable == sqm3]
sqm3_q <- unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmbPlot[[sqm3]], q_levels))
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep, 
  sqm3_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm3))

m7gpredR <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = grid_vars,
                                by=c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                                vcov=vc,
                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmbScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c(names(grid_vars)[-1], sqm3_orig)),
      ~ num_factor(.x, digits=2)
    ))

```

## UAS detectability

### fit and examine detectability only model

#### model 8 formula

```{r}

m8formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)

m8bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)

m8Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                            all.vars(m8formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m8formula, data=m8Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m8bformula, data=m8Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)


```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m8 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m8formula, data=m8Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m8b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m8bformula, data=m8Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m8, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m8b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m8_cv <- cv_glmgee(m8, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m8Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m8b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m8b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m8Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3i, m4, m5g, m6, m7g, m8, m8b)

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3i=m3i_cv,
                        m4=m4_cv, m5g=m5g_cv, m6=m6_cv, m7g=m7g_cv,
                        m8=m8_cv, m8b=m8b_cv))
```

```{r}
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +

  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_DetCal_geeQb"
  
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 9 formula

```{r}

m9formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd

m9Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m9formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m9bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd

m9bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m9bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m9cformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd

m9cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m9cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))


m9dformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd +
  UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASFluctECMA10ExStd +
  UASRoughECMA10ExStd

m9dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m9dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

```{r}
geeCorStr(m9bformula, data=m9bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)
```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m9cpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m9c, newdata=na.omit(m9cData),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m9c, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m9cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m9cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m9cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +

        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))),
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m9cformula, data = m9cData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m9cformula, data=m9cData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m9cData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(111111)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(111111)
m9e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-300, nlambda = 1000)

coef(m9e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m9e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m9e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean


# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m9e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m9e$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m9e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m9e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

```{r}
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_DetSQnetCal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

```{r}
pred_mod <- m9h

                                              variables = list(Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl=x_sweep),
```

## All metrics

### model 10 formula

```{r}

m10formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  PartSharpvBSHMPowAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  PartTonLdSHMPowAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + dFluctOV10ExStd + dRoughECMA05ExStd

m10Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m10bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  PartSharpvBSHMPowAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  dTonalECMAAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + dFluctOV10ExStd + dRoughECMA05ExStd

m10bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m10cformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  PartSharpvBSHMPowAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  PartTonLdSHMPowAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  dImpulsSHM05ExStd + dFluctOV10ExStd + dRoughECMA05ExStd

m10cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m10dformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436)*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  PartSharpvBSHMPowAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  dTonalECMAAvgStd*I(exp(0.02*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl) - 1.030487436) +
  dImpulsSHM05ExStd + dFluctOV10ExStd + dRoughECMA05ExStd

m10dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))



```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m10formula, data=m10Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m10bformula, data=m10bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m10cformula, data=m10cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m10dformula, data=m10dData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m10 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10formula, data=m10Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m10b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10bformula, data=m10bData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m10c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10cformula, data=m10cData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m10d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10dformula, data=m10dData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m10, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m10b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m10c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m10d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

### analyse performance

```{r}

m10_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m10b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m10c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10cData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m10d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10d, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10dData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3i, m4, m5g, m6, m7g,
                    m8b, m9h, m10, m10b, m10c, m10d)

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3i=m3i_cv, m4=m4_cv, m5g=m5g_cv,
                        m6=m6_cv, m7g=m7g_cv, m8b=m8b_cv, m9h=m9h_cv,
                        m10=m10_cv, m10b=m10b_cv, m10c=m10c_cv, m10d=m10d_cv))
```

### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m10dpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m10d, newdata=na.omit(m10dData),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m10d, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m10dpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m10dpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m10dpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```
