### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m10dformula, data = m10dData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m10dformula, data=m10dData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m10dData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(888888)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(888888)
m10e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-50, nlambda = 800)

coef(m10e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m10e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m10e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

col_pal <- randomcoloR::distinctColorPalette(k = length(unique(coefficient_paths$term)), altCol = FALSE, runTsne = FALSE)

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = col_pal) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m10e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m10e$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m10e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m10e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

 
if (saveplots){
    
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_DetdSQ_glmnetQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

```{r}
  dplyr::mutate(PartSharpvBSHMPowAvg = num_factor(PartSharpvBSHMPowAvg),
                dTonalECMAAvg     = num_factor(dTonalECMAAvg))
```

# Change in highly annoyed

## Benchmark categorical variables
(there is no model 11, we just jump to model 12 for convenience)
### model 12 formula

```{r}
# the interaction term between LAE and AmbientVariant caused numerical problems 
m12formula <- dProbHA20k ~ 1 + TrialNumberStd + AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)


m12Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m12formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m12bformula <- dProbHA20k ~ 1 + TrialNumberStd + AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientEnvCore*UASType + UASType*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  AmbientVariant + UASProximity + UASStart

m12bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m12bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))


# include personal factors
m12cformula <- update(m12formula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl +
                       Area_soundscape2)

m12cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m12cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m12dformula <- update(m12bformula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl +
                       Area_soundscape2)

m12dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m12dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m12formula, data=m12Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12bformula, data=m12bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12cformula, data=m12cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12dformula, data=m12dData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}


m12 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12formula, data=m12Data,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12bformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12cformula, data=m12cData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='ar(1)-dependent')

m12d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12dformula, data=m12dData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m12, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m12b, m12c, m12d)

m12_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,
                    seed=cv_seed, data=m12Data, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE, workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

m12b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,
                     seed=cv_seed, data=m12bData, agg_cols="StimID",
                     return_predictions=TRUE, workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

m12c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,
                     seed=cv_seed, data=m12cData, agg_cols="StimID",
                     return_predictions=TRUE, workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

m12d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12d, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,
                     seed=cv_seed, data=m12dData, agg_cols="StimID",
                     return_predictions=TRUE, workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m12b=m12b_cv,
                        m12c=m12c_cv, m12d=m12d_cv))

```

### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m12.resP <- residuals(m12, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE)

used <- complete.cases(m12Data[all.vars(m12formula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m12), m12.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m12Data$UASLAEMaxLRScl[used], m12.resP,
                 xlab = "UASLAEMaxLRScl")
arm::binnedplot(m12Data$UASEvents[used], m12.resP,
                 xlab = "UASEvents")
```

### test model interactions

#### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m12,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m12formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m12formula, data = m12Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m12formula, data=m12Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m12Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m12e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-8, nlambda = 500)

coef(m12e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m12e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m12e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

col_pal <- randomcoloR::distinctColorPalette(k = length(unique(coefficient_paths$term)), altCol = FALSE, runTsne = FALSE)

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = col_pal) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m12e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m12e$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m12e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m12e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m12predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=na.omit(m12Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents",
                                           "AmbientEnvCore",
                                           "AmbientVariant"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m12, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean -
                      m12predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean -
                                                       mean(stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m12predMeans,
                     measured_target='dProbHA20kMean', measured_ci_low='dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dProbHA20kMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m12predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dHiAnnoy_PredMod_BmarkCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 14 formula

```{r}

m14formula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
  UASFluctOV10ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd
m14formula

m14Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m14formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m14bformula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
  UASFluctOV10ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd
m14bformula

m14bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m14bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m14cformula <- update(m14formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)
m14cformula

m14cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m14cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))
  

m14dformula <- update(m14bformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)
m14dformula

m14dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m14dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m14d,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m14dformula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m14dformula, data = m14dData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m14dformula, data=m14dData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m14dData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m14e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m14e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m14e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m14e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14e$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),

```

#### fit elastic net-informed model

##### formula

```{r}

m14fformula <- update(m14dformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsSHMAvgStd - UASSharpvBISO105ExStd)
m14fformula

m14gformula <- update(m14dformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsSHMAvgStd - UASSharpvBISO105ExStd -
                        UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481))
m14gformula

m14hformula <- update(m14dformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsSHMAvgStd - UASSharpvBISO105ExStd -
                        UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) -
                        UASTonalECMA05ExStd)
m14hformula

m14iformula <- update(m14dformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsSHMAvgStd - UASSharpvBISO105ExStd -
                        UASTonalECMA05ExStd)
m14iformula

```

##### run model

###### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m14fformula, data=m14dData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14gformula, data=m14dData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14iformula, data=m14dData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

###### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m14f <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14fformula, data=m14dData,

m14g <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14gformula, data=m14dData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14h <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14hformula, data=m14dData,

m14i <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14iformula, data=m14dData,

geeParams(m14f, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

geeParams(m14h, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14i, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

##### analyse performance

```{r}

                                data=na.omit(m14dData), agg_cols="StimID",
```

```{r}

m14ipredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m14i, newdata=na.omit(m14dData),

  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +

  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

#### model 15 formula

```{r}

m15formula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore

m15Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                             all.vars(m15formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m15,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m15formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m15formula, data = m15Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m15formula, data=m15Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m15Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m15b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m15b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m15b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m15b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

col_pal <- randomcoloR::distinctColorPalette(k = length(unique(coefficient_paths$term)), altCol = FALSE, runTsne = FALSE)

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = col_pal) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m15b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m15b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m15b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m15b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

### full SQ model

#### model 16 formula

```{r}

m16formula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore + 
  UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
  UASFluctOV10ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd
m16formula

m16Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m16formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m16bformula <- update(m16formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)
m16bformula

m16bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m16bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m16formula, data=m16Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m16bformula, data=m16bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m16 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16formula, data=m16Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16bformula, data=m16bData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m16, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m16_cv <- cv_glmgee(m16, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m16Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

m16b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m16b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m16bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14i, m15, m16, m16b)

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14i=m14i_cv, m15=m15_cv,
                        m16=m16_cv, m16b=m16b_cv))

```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m16,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m16formula

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m16formula, data = m16Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m16formula, data=m16Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m16Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m16c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 500)

coef(m16c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m16c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m16c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

col_pal <- randomcoloR::distinctColorPalette(k = length(unique(coefficient_paths$term)), altCol = FALSE, runTsne = FALSE)

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_pal) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


```

##### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m16dpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m16d, newdata=na.omit(m16Data),

  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - m16dpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m16dpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dProbHA20kMean', measured_ci_low='dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dProbHA20kMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m16dpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +

  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

## UAS-env difference

### LAeqLAF10diff with events

#### model 17 formula

```{r}

m17formula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd + LAeqLAF10diffScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)

m17bformula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd + LAeqdiffScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)

m17Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m17formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m17bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m17bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m17formula, data=m17Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m17bformula, data=m17bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m17 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17formula, data=m17Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m17b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17bformula, data=m17bData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m17predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m17, newdata=na.omit(m17Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "LAeqLAF10diffScl",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m17, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - m17predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m17predMeans,
                     measured_target='dProbHA20kMean', measured_ci_low='dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dProbHA20kMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m17predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dHiAnnoy_PredMod_dLAeqCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 18 formula

```{r}

m18formula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd +
  LAeqLAF10diffScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
  UASFluctOV10ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd
m18formula

m18Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m18formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m18bformula <- update(m18formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
                        UASImpulsSHMAvgStd)
m18bformula

m18bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m18bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m18formula, data=m18Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m18bformula, data=m18bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)
```

```{r}
m18b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m18bformula, data=m18bData,

geeParams(m18, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m18b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m18,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')


modelStep$initial
modelStep$final


```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m18formula, data = m18Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m18formula, data=m18Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m18Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m18c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m18c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m18c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m18c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')



```

```{r}
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dHiAnnoy_PredMod_dLAeqSQnetCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

```{r}
# sqm 2

sqm2_orig <- subjDataNoAmbScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmbScaling$new_variable == sqm2]

  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c(names(grid_vars)[-1], sqm2_orig)),
      ~ num_factor(.x, digits=2)

# sqm 3

m18hpredR <- avg_predictions_hybrid(pred_mod, fitDat,
```

## UAS all metrics

### model 19 formula

```{r}

m19formula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd +
  UASLoudISO1PowAvgStd*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481) +
  UASImpulsLoudWZPowAvgStd + UASSharpAurISO1MedStd + dTonalAwSHM05ExStd +
  UASFluctFZ05ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd
m19formula

m19Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m19bformula <- update(m19formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZPowAvgStd +
                        dImpulsSHM05ExStd)
m19bformula

m19bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m19cformula <- update(m19formula, . ~ . - dTonalAwSHM05ExStd +
                        UASTonShpAurSHM05ExStd)
m19cformula

m19cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m19dformula <- update(m19formula, . ~ . - dTonalAwSHM05ExStd +
                        UASTonShpAurSHM05ExStd - UASImpulsLoudWZPowAvgStd +
                        dImpulsSHM05ExStd)
m19dformula

m19dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))


```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m19formula, data=m19Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m19bformula, data=m19bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m19cformula, data=m19cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m19dformula, data=m19dData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m19 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19formula, data=m19Data,
                          family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m19b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19bformula, data=m19bData,
                          family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m19c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19cformula, data=m19cData,
                          family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m19d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19dformula, data=m19dData,
                          family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m19, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m19b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m19c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

```{r}

m19dpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m19d, newdata=na.omit(m19dData),

  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - m19dpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m19dpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dProbHA20kMean', measured_ci_low='dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dProbHA20kMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m19dpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
    
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

#### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}
modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m19d,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m19dformula
modelStep$final

```

### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m19dformula, data = m19dData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m19dformula, data=m19dData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m19dData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m19e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-120, nlambda = 5000)

coef(m19e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m19e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m19e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19e$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dHiAnnoy_PredMod_AllSQ_glmnetQb"
 
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

```{r}
                                                     UASTonShpAurSHM05ExStd = "UASTonShpAurSHM05Ex",
                                                     dImpulsSHM05ExStd = "dImpulsSHM05Ex",
                                                     UASRoughDW10ExStd = "UASRoughDW10Ex",
                                                    UASFluctFZ05ExStd = "UASFluctFZ05Ex"),
                                 scaling_data = subjDataNoAmb,
                                 TrialNumberStd=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

## UAS psychoacoustic annoyance

### model 20 formula

```{r}

m20formula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd + UASPsychAnnoyWillemsenScl

m20Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m20formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m20bformula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd + UASPsychAnnoyWillemsenScl +
  I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)

m20bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m20bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dProbHA20k))

m20cformula <- dProbHA20k ~ TrialNumberStd +
  UASPsychAnnoyWillemsenScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.16481)

```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m20formula, data=m20Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m20bformula, data=m20bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m20cformula, data=m20bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m20 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m20formula, data=m20Data,
                          family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m20b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m20bformula, data=m20bData,
                          family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m20c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m20cformula, data=m20bData,
                          family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m20, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m20b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m20c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

### analyse performance

```{r}

m20_cv <- cv_glmgee(m20, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m20Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

m20b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m20b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m20bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

m20c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m20c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m20bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14i, m15, m16d, m17, m18h, m19i, m20, m20b, m20c)

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14i=m14i_cv, m15=m15_cv,
                        m16d=m16d_cv, m17=m17_cv, m18h=m18h_cv, m19i=m19i_cv,
                        m20=m20_cv, m20b=m20b_cv, m20c=m20c_cv))

```

### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m20c.resP <- residuals(m20c, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE)

used <- complete.cases(m20bData[all.vars(m20cformula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m20c), m20c.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m20bData$UASPsychAnnoyWillemsenScl[used], residuals(m20c, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASPsychAnnoyWillemsenScl")
arm::binnedplot(m20bData$UASEvents[used], residuals(m20c, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASEvents")
arm::binnedplot(m20bData$TrialNumberStd[used], residuals(m20c, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "TrialNumberStd")

m20c.resM <- residuals(m20c, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m20c,
                    clusterVar=m20c.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m20c.Cook <- cooks.distance(m20c, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m20c, clusterVar=m20c.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m20c)

```

##### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m20cpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m20c, newdata=na.omit(m20bData),
                                      by=c("StimID"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m20c, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - m20cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m20cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dProbHA20kMean', measured_ci_low='dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dProbHA20kMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m20cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dProbHA20kMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dHiAnnoy_PredMod_AllPAnetCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```
